cells.items: Scalar/numeric/string/UUID/URL/email/IP/date/time/duration/choice/list/dict/JSON/file/image; model relation and hyperlink; computed field
cells.rule: Required/default/null/blank/source/label/help, min/max/length/precision; read-only/write-only/hidden; unknown fields rejected by default.

cells.items: Serializer, ModelSerializer, ListSerializer, nested values/relations, explicit Create/Update, partial updates
cells.rule: Nested writes require declared policy and transaction; no automatic cascading assignment of writable relation IDs.

cells.items: Function handler, APIView, generic CRUD, ResourceSet, ReadOnlyResourceSet, router actions and custom route registration
cells.rule: Resource supplies QueryScope and permission policy; field projection allowlist; read and mutation checks independent.

cells.items: JSON, multipart, URL form, text, streaming JSON; extension codecs; Accept/Content-Type; versioned resources
cells.rule: 415 for unsupported input; 406 for unacceptable output; body bounded; browser documentation view opt-in and access-controlled.

cells.items: Session/token/basic authentication adapters; resource/object permissions; action policies; throttling; filtering/search/ordering
cells.rule: Basic over TLS only and disabled by default; throttle not authorization; all filter fields/operators allowlisted.

cells.items: Page number, limit/offset, signed cursor; count; empty page; orphans and elided ranges for HTML
cells.rule: Stable unique tiebreaker; cursor bound to query/scope/version; enforce max size; invalid cursor 400.

cells.items: OpenAPI document, schema validation, versioning, route naming, browsable docs, generated client interface hooks
cells.rule: Schema derived from same serializer/resource metadata; hide private endpoints; contract changes reviewed before release.

cells.items: Field/nonfield errors, stable code/status, request ID, conflict and retry headers
cells.rule: No stack traces/SQL/secrets in production; input values redacted in diagnostics.

cells.items: Request factory/client, forced test identity, auth/session/token tests, schema checks, content negotiation cases
cells.rule: Testing bypasses available only through testing package; production handlers never infer test privileges.
